```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(kernlab)
library(e1071)
library(NeuralNetTools)
library(neuralnet)
library(class)
```


```{r}
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Load the AIBL data
aibl_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/bless/Desktop/Project/ML/Master.csv", header = TRUE)

dim(aibl_data)
# Data preprocessing
# Combine MCI and AD categories into Non-HC
aibl_data$Diagnosis <- ifelse(aibl_data$Diagnosis == 1 , "HC", "Non-HC")
aibl_data$Diagnosis <- factor(aibl_data$Diagnosis)

```


```{r}
# Feature Engineering
# Binning

aibl_data$MMSCORE <- ifelse(aibl_data$MMSCORE < 9, "sever", 
          ifelse(aibl_data$MMSCORE >= 10 & aibl_data$MMSCORE < 20,"modest",
          ifelse(aibl_data$MMSCORE >= 20 & aibl_data$MMSCORE < 24,"early", "normal")))

aibl_data$MMSCORE <- as.factor(aibl_data$MMSCORE)
aibl_data$MMSCORE <- as.numeric(aibl_data$MMSCORE)


# table(aibl_data$MMSCORE)

```

```{r}

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(aibl_data))
sum(is.null(aibl_data))

# Check for duplicate values and remove duplicates
duplicated_rows <- aibl_data[duplicated(aibl_data), ]
aibl_data <- unique(aibl_data)

# Remove rows with missing values
aibl_data <- na.omit(aibl_data)

# Export data to a CSV file
write.csv(aibl_data, file = "C:/Users/bless/Desktop/Project/ML/Master_my_data.csv")

```
Smote technique is applied in Weka to balance the classes.

```{r}

# Load the new AIBL data after SMOTE
aibl_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/bless/Desktop/Project/ML/CW/Master_my_data.csv", header = TRUE)

dim(aibl_data)
aibl_data$Diagnosis <- factor(aibl_data$Diagnosis)

```

```{r}
aibl_data <- aibl_data[,-1]
# 
# Reshape the data from wide to long format using gather
aibl_data_long <- aibl_data %>% 
  gather(key = "variable", value = "value", -Diagnosis)

# Create a box plot of all variables by Diagnosis using facet_wrap
ggplot(aibl_data_long, aes(x = Diagnosis, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Diagnosis", y = "value") +
  ggtitle("Box Plot of AIBL Dataset by Variable")

```

```{r}

# Remove irrelevant variables

# Recursive feature selection (RFE)
ctrl <- rfeControl(functions = rfFuncs, method = "cv", number = 5)
rfProfile <- rfe(aibl_data[,1:(ncol(aibl_data)-1)], aibl_data$Diagnosis, sizes = c(1:(ncol(aibl_data)-1)), rfeControl = ctrl)
print(rfProfile$optVariables)

aibl_data_Re <- aibl_data[, c(rfProfile$optVariables,"Diagnosis")]

# correlation
cor_features <- findCorrelation(cor(aibl_data[, -ncol(aibl_data)]), cutoff = 0.5)
aibl_data_fs <- aibl_data[, c(1, cor_features + 1)]


```

```{r}


# Split data into training and testing sets
train_index <- createDataPartition(aibl_data_Re$Diagnosis,
                                   p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- aibl_data_Re[train_index, ]
test_data <- aibl_data_Re[-train_index, ]

# Feature scaling
train_data[, -ncol(train_data)] <- scale(train_data[, -ncol(train_data)])
test_data[, -ncol(test_data)] <- scale(test_data[, -ncol(test_data)])

test_data$Diagnosis <- as.factor(test_data$Diagnosis)
train_data$Diagnosis <- as.factor(train_data$Diagnosis)


```


```{r}
# Model training and evaluation

# k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) model and create confusion matrix
knn_model <- knn(train = train_data[, -ncol(test_data)], 
                 test = test_data[, -ncol(test_data)], 
                 cl = train_data$Diagnosis, k = 5)
knn_cm <- confusionMatrix(knn_model, test_data$Diagnosis)
print(knn_cm)

# Random forest (RF) model
rf_model <- randomForest(Diagnosis ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500)
rf_predict <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
rf_cm <- confusionMatrix(rf_predict, test_data$Diagnosis)
print(rf_cm)

# Support vector machine (SVM) model
svm_model <- ksvm(Diagnosis ~ ., data = train_data, 
                  type = "C-svc", kernel = "rbfdot", 
                  kpar = list(sigma = 0.1), C = 100)
svm_predict <- predict(svm_model, test_data)
svm_cm <- confusionMatrix(svm_predict, test_data$Diagnosis)
print(svm_cm)

```
